Title: General availability: Web Application Firewall (WAF) geomatch custom rules on Application Gateway

Body.Content:
We are announcing the general availability of the Web Application Firewall (WAF) geomatch custom rule feature on Application Gateway. This feature allows users to restrict access to their web applications by country/region. As with all custom rules, this logic can be compounded with other rules to suit the needs of your application. 

See our geomatch custom rules documentation to learn more.
